english_title: Andreas Vesalius publishes his work on human anatomy
english_popup: 'This is considered to be the first great modern work of science and the base of modern biology. In it, Vesalius makes new observations about the structure of the human body.'

english_title: Nicolas Copernicus publishes his work on planets
english_popup: 'Copernicus proposes that the Sun, not the Earth, is the center of our solar system. This is called the heliocentric theory.'

english_title: Giordano Bruno talks of the infinite universe
english_popup: 'The rebellious Italian monk talks about his philosophy, including his argument that the universe is infinitely large and that the Earth is not at the center of it.'
'The invention of analytical trigonometry, a branch of mathematics involving the position of trigonometric identities, is key to the study of physics and astronomy.'

english_title: Galileo Galilei demonstrates the properties of gravity
english_popup: 'Galileo shows, from the top of the leaning tower of Pisa, that a one-pound weight and a one hundred-pound weight dropped at the same moment hit the ground at the same time. This proves that the rate of fall of an object is not dependent upon its weight.'

english_title: Galileo publishes his booklet on moons
english_popup: 'This 24-page booklet describes observations made by Galileo of the surface of the moon, and of the moons orbiting Jupiter, making the Church afraid. The Inquisition soon warns Galileo to stop spreading his theories.'
'Napier invents a new way of arranging logarithms, which is an essential step in simplifying calculations.'

english_title: Johannes Kepler reveals his last law on planetary motion
english_popup: 'Kepler`s laws of planetary motion describe the form and movement of planetary paths, and are the final step leading to the academic rejection of the Aristotelian system.'

english_title: Francis Bacon tries to relate different sciences
english_popup: 'Bacon attempts to create organization and cooperation within the scientific community by demonstrating how the many different fields of science relate to one another.'

english_title: Galileo proves the Earth is not the center of the solar system
english_popup: 'Galileo`s greatest work uses the laws of physics to prove wrong the Aristotelian argument that the Earth is the center of the solar system and supports the heliocentric theory. english_title: The Church forces Galileo to withdraw

english_popup: 'The Royal Society brings together the greatest minds of the region in efforts to advance science through cooperation. english_title: Germany seizes the Netherlands and more
